debugData.name: Terrain
debugData.description: The toolkit's terrain material generator (p305) through its JSON route: staticDefines.terrain is createTerrainMaterial's config without its id and texture ids (layers' settings; uv; blend SINGLE, VERTEX_COLOR, SPLAT_MAP, RULES or a painted source with rules, by height or linear; antiTiling; projection with a slope gate; macro; sparse; colorMap; distance with a far surface; space; quality tiers and qualityLevel; debugView). The inputs: layer0, layer1, … the layers' texture sets ({ textureSet, packing? }, all in one packing), or layers one set array for the imported sets ({ textureSetArray: [ids], packing }, a procedural set's layer keeping its own layer<i>); splat0 and splat1 the splat maps, macro the macro texture (also the rules' noise), colorMap the colour map ({ texture }). The texture budget is 16 a stage less reservedTextures (6). Give a mesh its sets with matOverrides.inputs; a set array material is a material JSON of its own.
